discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 237 (B103), 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked; reuses 237 keys. Coin W3: per-pin store listings found for Dopey, Mushu, Eeyore, Ursula (holds resolved for those); Figaro, Remy, Tiana, Stitch, Beast still held. Prince Shields year resolved to 2025 (store blog dated 18 Dec 2025). Princess/Villains jumbo: 5 pairing designs recorded from Mouseketeer but date hold kept. New: Dance Season 2026 (2 multi-character pins), Pixar Coin Anxiety (2025). Micro/mystery designs (Sidekicks, Goofy, Descendants, Zootopia, Tinker Bell, Cupcakes, UP, Tales) still unnamed. No 2025-26 manufacturer found; Uncas International credited only on a 2023 series.
